description:
The Corsini Gallery in Rome preserves the character of an eighteenth-century cardinal’s picture collection in its original palace setting. The family’s donation helped establish Italy’s national collection of older art.

Paintings and historic furnishings connect the collection with the patronage of Cardinal Neri Maria Corsini and the artistic culture of Baroque Rome.

Its museum collections encompass the Palatine Gallery, royal apartments, modern art, fashion and costume, and decorative treasures, linking several artistic histories within one palace.
